description: An oil-painted scene at dusk: a large dark semi truck with a boxy trailer sits in the foreground on a dirt road, headlights on, with a line of similar trucks receding into dusty haze on the left. On the right a raised striped barrier arm angles up beside a small wooden guard booth with dark windows. The sky glows orange behind distant mountains with a low sun, and a radio antenna stands at the far right. No visible text, border or frame; the painting fills the canvas edge to edge.
